# Security Policy

Thank you for helping keep this plugin and the sites that run it safe.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released against the **latest version** published on WordPress.org and in this repository. Older releases are not patched, so keeping the plugin up to date is the most reliable protection.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest release | ✅ |
| Older releases | ❌ |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, pull requests, or the WordPress.org support forum.**

Report them privately using GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

**[Report a vulnerability →](https://github.com/joshuadavidnelson/disable-blog/security/advisories/new)**

If you are unable to use GitHub, you can email the maintainer at josh@joshuadnelson.com with "SECURITY" in the subject line.

To help triage the report quickly, please include as much of the following as you can:

- The plugin version(s) affected.
- The type of issue (for example: capability check bypass, information disclosure, cross-site scripting).
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce it, including any required configuration, user role, or request details.
- The impact, including how an attacker might exploit it.

## What to expect

This plugin is maintained by a single volunteer, so response times vary. You should hear back within **7 days** to confirm the report was received, and within **30 days** with an assessment and expected timeline. If you have not heard back in that time, a follow-up on the advisory thread is welcome and helpful.

Once a fix is released on WordPress.org, the advisory is published and you will be credited unless you ask not to be. Please allow a reasonable window for sites to update before any public disclosure.

Vulnerabilities in WordPress core or other plugins should go to their maintainers. For plugins that appear abandoned or unresponsive, the [WordPress.org plugin review team](https://developer.wordpress.org/plugins/wordpress-org/plugin-security/reporting-plugin-security-issues/) can be contacted at plugins@wordpress.org.
